{{Quote|I doubt there's another dealer in the woods who even knows how to price this.|Tinch to Luthen Rael|<ref name="MakeItStop" />}}
'''Tinch'''<ref name="MakeItStop" /> was a [[Gender|female]]<ref name="AD" /> [[human]] who worked as a shopkeeper during the [[Imperial Era]]. She had bought and sold used curios for many years. Her shop was built out of a [[starship]] that had been grounded for a long time, with living quarters in a tent in the space above.<ref name="DB" /> At one point during the early [[Imperial Era]], [[Luthen Rael]] and [[Kleya Marki]] tried to sell Tinch a carved figurine weighing one [[kilogram]]. Rael asked for the price of twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard|Credits]] and Tinch made a counteroffer of seven, but Marki haggled up the price to eighteen Credits.<ref name="MakeItStop" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tinch was portrayed by [[Juliet Cowan]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], first appearing in the tenth episode, "[[Make It Stop]],"<ref name="MakeItStop" /> aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The character's name was revealed in the final credits for the episode.<ref name="MakeItStop" />
